descriptions.text: Relive your favorite memories with this blast from the past! The Love This Memory Notebook Kit is the perfect way to preserve amazing moments from your life in a fun and colorful way. Gather up photos and paste them into the included notebook and decorate! Whether you document gorgeous summer days at the beach or your kid’s first baseball game, the Love This Memory Notebook Kit is a simple way to make your memories feel brand new again. Also available in French. Kit includes: * Predesigned projects * Step-by-step instructions * Precut pieces (No prep work! Get right to crafting) * Makes one 8-1/2"" x 5-1/4"" (21.6 x 13.3 cm) kraft notebook * Sticker sheets (with holographic foil and a full alphabet) * Holographic washi tape * Printed cards to decorate with * A Classic Stampin’ Spot in Parakeet Party * The exclusive Love This Photopolymer Stamp Set * Enough adhesive to complete projects * A printed box for storage or crafting on the go * Coordinating colors: Basic Black,

descriptions.text: Help us make a difference with the Nourish & Flourish Kit! Food scarcity is an issue facing communities across the globe. And with your help, we hope to make a difference. descriptions.text: Create perfect cutouts of rhinos and more with these Rhino Ready Dies. You’ll love all the fun options that come along with these cute little critters! Set a playful scene using the three different rhino shapes plus trees, leaves, bushes, grass, and more. Cut out the pieces, then color and assemble anyway you like for playful, happy rhinoceros elements you can use for card making, scrapbooking, and other paper crafting projects. * 17 dies * Largest die: 2-1/8" x 2" (5.4 x 5.1 cm) * Use with a Stampin’ Cut & Emboss Machine * Compatible with the Mini Stampin’ Cut & Emboss Machine Dies help you create unique die-cut shapes and paper cutouts with just a quick run through your Stampin’ Cut & Emboss Machine. Detailed dies include ejection holes so you can remove the paper easily.

images.description: A collection of gray silhouette illustrations featuring African safari and wildlife theme elements including trees, an elephant, hippopotamus, lion, giraffe, various plants, leaves, bushes, clouds, a volcano, and small decorative botanical elements arranged on a light beige background.

A collection of metal die-cut templates featuring safari and jungle-themed elements including two hippopotamus shapes in different sizes, acacia trees, monstera and palm leaves, clouds, bushes, a small party hat, and a decorative frame. The dies are shown as outlined metal shapes in grayscale against a neutral background.
